reason: A DSH Web plugin that adds a configurable eye-care color theme with light, dark, and system-theme support, while remembering the user’s toggle state.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加可切换的护眼配色主题，支持浅色、深色和跟随系统模式并记忆开关状态。
summaries.en: Adds a switchable eye-care color theme to the DSH Web interface with light, dark, system-following modes, and persistent toggle state.

capabilities: Adds a DSH Web interface eye-care theme toggle
Applies custom colors across light and dark themes
Persists the theme preference in browser localStorage
Provides installation and removal scripts for the DSH plugin environment
